request.query: Studies using the UCI Wine Quality data or related wine sensory datasets that test local multivariate physicochemical similarity against sensory quality-score disagreement, including label-permutation or conditional-randomization references
request.missing_relation: Whether local chemistry-to-score concordance with residual disagreement is already a studied question, beyond general wine-quality prediction, outlier detection, or feature selection
request.change_if_found: If a close study tests this relation and contrast, classify I1 as literature-overlapping and refine toward a prespecified unresolved measurement or sampling source; otherwise retain only as a candidate question with novelty still unverified.
